items.title: Stew for the Sick
items.text: Half the lane has a fever, dearie. Cook me a Hunter's Stew at the hearth by your house. Mutton, onion and salt, you can get them all from Goody Pell.

items.title: Cakes for the Children
items.text: The little ones are frightened of the raids. Some honey cakes would cheer them. Bring me two.

items.title: A Pie Fit for a Soldier
items.text: My grandson guards the gates. Bake him an Ember-Baked Pie in a proper stone oven. You'll need an imp's coal from the Foundry.

items.title: Put Down Roots
items.text: A homestead with no garden? Shameful. Build an Herb Garden on your plot. Goody Pell sells timber and rope.

items.title: Fire and Stone
items.text: Now a Stone Bread Oven. Dressed stone and a little timber. You'll eat like a lord.

items.title: A Keen Edge
items.text: Use the plans I gave you and build that Grinding Wheel. A dull blade gets a man killed.

items.title: Bounty: Gnarlings
items.text: The Catacombs are crawling with Gnarlings. Bring me three of their ears and I'll pay the village bounty.

items.title: What the Hollowed Carry
items.text: The Hollowed were our neighbours once. Bring back two of their lockets so the families can bury something.

items.title: Trophies of the Foundry
items.text: Prove the Foundry can be beaten. Two Rotfang tusks and two Imp embers, and the village will pay for a bathhouse of your own.

items.title: Poison Against Poison
items.text: Bog Crawlers carry venom sacs. Bring me two and I'll show you how to build a still that brews the cure.

items.title: Garlic for the Watch
items.text: The marsh patrol keeps coming back poisoned. Cook them two Garlic Broths. Granny Hobb knows the recipe.

items.title: The Master's Cure
items.text: Now brew a Venom Theriac in your own still and bring it to me. If you can make it, you can survive the Abbey.
